LIFE-163: Near-miss households need a second look

Caseworkers report that some families just below the eligibility cutoff are clearly in
need. Their scores may be off by a few points because of incomplete interviews.

Ask: add needs_review(household) to eligibility/rules.py. It returns True for every
active household that does not qualify yet but is within 5 points of qualifying, so a
caseworker can review it, and False otherwise. Use the household's vulnerability score.

Done when: exactly the near-miss households are flagged, and households that already
qualify are not.
